create_DefaultGripperEffector: create a DefaultGripperEffector instance from a RobotHand gripper and robot name string
build_gripper_action_spec: build the gripper action spec by calling action_spec with a Mujoco physics object
set_gripper_control: set gripper control commands by passing a physics object and numpy command array
initialize_gripper_episode: initialize the gripper effector for a new episode with physics and random state
review_gripper_prefix: review the DefaultGripperEffector prefix property to get the effector name prefix string
